Return transfer to Kalka (train) and onward travel to Delhi – relaxed departure

lunch.location_note: near Viceregal Lodge — approx 0.3 km from hotel

Mild butter paneer with rice – reliable group‑friendly option
Premium multi‑course meal with local Kashmiri delicacies – splurge before departure

days.notes: Viceregal Lodge has a few steps; use ramp and avoid upper floors if stairs become uncomfortable for the child.

warnings: Steep walk to Jakhu Temple (2.5 km) is avoided by using the rope‑way; otherwise it could tire an 8‑year‑old.
Viceregal Lodge interior includes some stairs; use the ramp and limit time on upper levels for child safety.
April evenings in Shimla can be chilly (down to 10 °C); carry warm layers for the family.
Steep 2.5 km walk to Jakhu Temple from Mall Road may be tiring for an 8‑year‑old; mitigate by taking the ropeway (₹250 each way from near Cart Road) or a shared taxi.

Hotels situated below the Ridge (Cart Road, Lakkar Bazaar) require steep uphill walks to Mall Road, which can be fatiguing for a child; mitigate by choosing accommodation on or near Mall Road or The Ridge (e.g., Hotel Willow Banks, Hotel Combermere).
Viceregal Lodge interior includes some stairs; while generally manageable, use the ramp or skip upper floors if the child finds stairs uncomfortable.
Kid‑friendly soft foods such as plain dosa, idli, roti/paratha and Maggi are readily available on Mall Road, ensuring easy meals for picky eaters.
Even in April, temperatures can drop sharply at night; carry warm layers as advised for year‑round cool evenings.
April falls before the peak May‑June rush, so crowds and prices are moderate; however, book accommodation and transport 3–4 weeks ahead to secure mid‑range rates.
personalization_notes: Heritage sites (Christ Church, Viceregal Lodge) match your interest in history.
Nature outings (Kufri meadow, Jakhu ridge) cater to the ‘nature’ trip style while keeping walks short for the child.
Mid‑range dining with specific kid‑friendly dishes ensures the 8‑year‑old enjoys familiar soft foods.
